name: v140_total_debt_slope_subindustry
hypothesis: The v139 total debt/assets slope was strong but failed sub-universe Sharpe. Subindustry ranking and a milder technical risk term may reduce cross-industry leverage structure noise.
expression: 0.500 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta(debt / assets, 252), 126), subindustry) + 0.230 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta(debt_lt / assets, 252), 126), subindustry) + 0.170 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (beta_last_60_days_spy - beta_last_360_days_spy), 90), industry) + 0.100 * rank(-1 * ts_rank(returns * (volume / adv20), 10))
notes: Repair of 2r76axK6 LOW_SUB_UNIVERSE_SHARPE; no AQI, FCF, operating-income, social, or guidance legs.

name: v140_largecap_total_debt_slope
hypothesis: Sub-universe failure may come from unstable small-cap balance-sheet updates. A large-cap gate can keep the deleveraging slope but remove noisy small names.
expression: trade_when(rank(cap) > 0.55, 0.520 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta(debt / assets, 252), 126), industry) + 0.220 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta(debt_lt / assets, 252), 126), industry) + 0.140 * rank(-1 * ts_mean(returns, 5)) + 0.120 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry), -1)
notes: Large-cap/liquid repair for 2r76axK6; strict-check against quality and guidance actives.

name: v140_high_leverage_deleveraging
hypothesis: Debt reduction should matter more for firms that are still levered. Gating on high debt/assets may turn the signal from generic low-debt quality into active balance-sheet repair.
expression: trade_when(rank(debt / assets) > 0.55, 0.520 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta(debt / assets, 252), 126), industry) + 0.250 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta(debt_st / assets, 126), 126), industry) + 0.130 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * net_interest_paid / assets, 126), industry) + 0.100 * rank(-1 * ts_mean(returns, 5)), -1)
notes: Mechanism parent is high-leverage repair, not static low debt; should reduce overlap with static debt/assets ACTIVE alphas.

name: v140_debt_sales_slope
hypothesis: Debt/assets can inherit asset-quality noise. Debt-to-sales decline asks whether leverage is falling relative to revenue capacity, a different scaling of the same deleveraging idea.
expression: 0.460 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta(debt / sales, 252), 126), industry) + 0.240 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta(debt_st / sales, 126), 126), industry) + 0.150 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * debt / sales, 126), industry) + 0.150 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)
notes: Alternative denominator repair for v139; no value-sales or gross-profit terms.

name: v140_short_debt_share_relief
hypothesis: Short-debt pressure can be expressed as current debt share of current liabilities, not just current debt/assets. A falling share should capture refinancing stress relief.
expression: 0.420 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta(debt_st / liabilities_curr, 126), 126), subindustry) + 0.260 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta(liabilities_curr / assets, 126), 126), industry) + 0.180 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * net_interest_paid / assets, 126), industry) + 0.140 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)
notes: Repair of ZYpzjGbd by changing denominator and subindustry comparison.

name: v140_maturity_wall_relief
hypothesis: Upcoming maturity obligations falling relative to assets should capture refinancing-risk improvement more directly than total debt balances.
expression: 0.400 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * debt_maturities_repayments_next12m / assets, 126), industry) + 0.250 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta(debt_maturities_repayments_next12m / assets, 126), 126), industry) + 0.200 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * debt_st / assets, 126), industry) + 0.150 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)
notes: Distinct refinancing-stress parent; uses footnote maturity wall rather than total debt level.

name: v140_interest_burden_pure_relief
hypothesis: v139 interest coverage was strong but too quality-correlated because of operating income. Removing operating income tests pure interest-burden relief from debt service pressure.
expression: 0.400 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta(interest_expense / assets, 126), 126), industry) + 0.270 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * net_interest_paid / assets, 126), industry) + 0.200 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta(debt / assets, 252), 126), industry) + 0.130 * rank(-1 * ts_mean(returns, 5))
notes: Decorrelation attempt for QPazEQRw without operating_income/FCF/AQI.

name: v140_lowvol_short_debt_relief
hypothesis: Debt improvement may be underreacted in calm, low-volatility regimes and more crowded during eventful periods. Low-vol gating may preserve short-debt strength while changing the PnL path.
expression: trade_when(ts_rank(abs(returns), 20) < 0.60, 0.410 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * ts_delta(debt_st / assets, 126), 126), industry) + 0.250 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * debt_st / assets, 126), industry) + 0.210 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * net_interest_paid / assets, 126), industry) + 0.130 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * beta_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry), -1)
notes: Regime repair for ZYpzjGbd; no social/customer/news terms to avoid QPazq9nX/Vkp0P130 correlation.
